description: FP32 GEMV benchmark using cuBLAS (NVIDIA) or rocBLAS (AMD). Computes y = A * x where A is M×N (row-major, FP32), x is N-vector, y is M-vector. Memory-bandwidth bound. Reports both GB/s and GFLOPS.

scaling_param.name: matrix_dim
scaling_param.description: Square matrix dimension M=N; controls matrix size and memory traffic

non_scaling_params.name: warmup
non_scaling_params.description: Number of warmup iterations before timing

non_scaling_params.name: iters
non_scaling_params.description: Number of timed iterations for averaging
